cases.name: Pamela Gail Berenson Cohen
cases.about: Her obituary aid, "Pam graduated from Cony High School and Husson University. Her quiet motivation to help people manifested in her chosen work as a special educator at RSU 25 in Bucksport. In retirement Pam committed herself to volunteering at The Ark and TurnStyle in Blue Hill and at the Brooklin Keeping Society."
